81788.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c1c9af72-58d8-47c5-88eb-8e5007f7e3dc/unnamed__17_.png?t=1789144554)
Caption: 

Written by Yogita Khatri  | Edited by Zack Abrams

———————————————————————————

Presented By:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/cc9ba07b-cd89-4828-ba71-d1e67518d2c2/logo.png?t=1793475707) [NEXO]
Follow image link: (https://nexo.com/en-us/borrow?utm_source=theblock&utm_campaign=theblock_newsletter_credit)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

----------
Happy Sunday, and welcome to the 63rd edition of [The Funding](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding)!

This week's record Binance hack comes at a tough time for crypto capital, when raising money was already hard for both funds and startups. I caught up with investors and analysts on what it means for fundraising, hedge funds, dealmaking, and TradFi's push into crypto, and what's ahead.

Let's get into it.


----------———————————————————————————

----------
# THE INSIDE VIEW

## What the Binance hack means for crypto capital


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8713115b-28df-45c2-86b7-05f08b1239ba/20241127_Binance_News_4-1200x675.jpg?t=1793392023)
Caption: 

----------
Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, [was hacked on Thursday](https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-29-binance-investigating-hack-suspicious-outflows-5-billion-432171), with about $6.3 billion drained from its hot wallets, [the largest crypto theft to date](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-30-binance-hack-largest-crypto-hack-north-korea-432225).

Binance says a compromised engineer's laptop gave the attackers access to its withdrawal systems. On Saturday, the FBI attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking group. Binance began reopening withdrawals in phases early Sunday, which resulted in [around $3.64 billion worth of net outflows](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-01-binance-sees-3-64-billion-in-net-outflows-after-reopening-withdrawals-following-record-hack-432259), though Binance said the initial spike later abated.

Binance has pledged to cover losses from its own pockets, and [has already readied $6.3 billion in capital](https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2026-10-30-binance-says-it-has-6-34-billion-ready-to-cover-hack-losses-432208) to do so, but what does the hack mean for crypto capital more broadly?

Raising money has [already been tough](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2026-04-19-the-funding-why-the-bar-for-crypto-vc-is-higher-than-ever-398015) for early-stage startups and smaller funds for some time, and [larger rounds](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2026-08-11-the-funding-how-th
